title: Splicing Hints into Reasoning Traces: Learning from Demonstrator Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.13996v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves mathematical reasoning when a final answer can be checked, but a correct answer does not certify the derivation behind it, and proof problems offer no answer to check. Replacing the check with a reasoning model as an in-loop verifier faces a fundamental obstacle: the policy must already produce occasional correct attempts for any reward to exist, which it may never do at olympiad level. We instead move verification and repair out of the training loop and into offline data generation with SPLICE, a workflow in which a second model, given only a reference solution, edits a reasoning model's traces as they are generated: it verifies progress, truncates a failed trace at its last verified step, and splices in an adaptively strengthened hint until progress resumes. The resulting dataset includes repaired examples whose sampled unaided trajectory failed, with failed continuations remove

translated_title: 将提示拼接进推理轨迹：从演示者的失败中学习
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习在最终答案可以被检查时能够改进数学推理，但正确的答案并不能证明其背后推导过程的有效性，而证明类问题则没有可供检查的答案。用推理模型作为循环内验证器来替代检查面临一个根本性障碍：策略必须已经能够偶尔产生正确的尝试，奖励信号才会存在，而在奥赛级别的问题上这种尝试可能永远不会出现。我们转而将验证和修复从训练循环中移出，放到离线数据生成阶段，提出了SPLICE——一种工作流程，其中第二个模型仅依据参考解答，在推理模型轨迹生成的过程中对其进行编辑：它验证推理进度，在最后一个被验证的步骤处截断失败的轨迹，并拼接进自适应增强的提示，直到推理进度得以恢复。由此产生的数据集包含了修复后的样本，这些样本的自主采样轨迹原本是失败的，其中失败的部分被移除。
tldr: 该论文提出SPLICE工作流程，通过第二个模型在离线数据生成时实时验证推理进度、截断失败轨迹并自适应地拼接提示进行修复，从而从演示者的失败中学习，克服了证明类问题缺乏可验证答案及循环内验证的根本性障碍。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SPLICE, a workflow in which a second model verifies reasoning progress in real time, truncates failed traces at their last verified step, and adaptively splices in strengthened hints during offline data generation, learning from demonstrator failures to overcome the fundamental obstacle of in-loop verification for proof problems.
